current_runtime_router.role: Global preferred/effective WORK|WEB|CODEX selection; explicit STORY_OS_RUNTIME override; WebCodex-health-to-Codex fallback; emits capability facts.

task_to_provider_model_selection.task_entry_mapping: config/agent_runtime/router.json routes request intent to workflow entry steps; it does not choose per-task provider/model.
task_to_provider_model_selection.workflow_execution: episodes/_system/runtime_dag.py owns DAG dispatch and invokes existing scheduler and adapters.
task_to_provider_model_selection.task_adapter_selection: episodes/_system/product_runtime_adapter.py branches by task type and existing adapter flags; review/model settings are read from existing runtime config or task-specific producers.
task_to_provider_model_selection.finding: No unified task-level capability-based provider/model router currently exists.

capability_and_health_representation.cached_episode_capabilities: episodes/_system/runtime_capability_cache.py stores runtime capability evidence with configured TTL; not a new authority/state machine.
capability_and_health_representation.provider_profiles: config/providers/index.json and episodes/_system/provider_capability.py describe image-provider capabilities and receipt constraints.
capability_and_health_representation.workspace_health: workspace_provider/WebCodex availability evidence is consulted by runtime_router.
capability_and_health_representation.adapter_flags: config/storyos.yaml agent_runtime.adapters contains per-adapter shadow/production/fallback flags.

fallback_locations: runtime_router.py: effective runtime may use Codex CLI if configured WebCodex provider is unavailable and Codex fallback is enabled; explicit runtime override takes precedence.
product_runtime_adapter.py: adapter-specific technical fallback flags preserve existing legacy paths.
image provider runtime: image API to Codex image execution fallback is separate from authoring/runtime task routing.
runtime_failure_strategy.py and runtime_dag.py: execution failure recovery/next action remains under existing DAG/runtime owner.

scheduler_owner.authority: Runtime DAG remains the only workflow runnable owner; runtime_scheduler computes dependency/resource allocations and does not create a second runtime or commit authority. Image work remains delegated to image_scheduler.

candidate_insertion_point.location: Extend existing runtime_router decision evidence and runtime_dag/product_runtime_adapter dispatch with a shadow-only task capability suggestion. Keep Runtime DAG as sole runnable owner; shadow proposal cannot replace selected executor or mutate episode/authority.
candidate_insertion_point.target_design_source: Architecture document P4 Task Capability Router section and health TTL section.

not_found: No current task-level required/optional/forbidden capability router with dynamic health TTL and shadow-vs-legacy comparison was found.
No second router service/daemon/scheduler should be introduced.
